humanAcceptance.evidence:
Dave instructed: 'Atomic acres pass and publish' on 2026-08-04 (06:51Z), standing up PASS 68 as the HITL-tested build while PASS 69 (Farcrysis map) is prepared as the next lane. Approval recorded against the immutable PR #39 preview (source 1d2565be) per repo contract; original PASS 68 request received 2026-08-03 with the full fix list below. Test-only re-pin 2026-08-04: frozen-timeout source contract updated to 60s deferred admission; runtime tree byte-identical to approved preview (recordImmediateStreak hook reverted). Preview sourceSha re-pinned to fixing head.

Test-only re-pin 2026-08-04: bumped pass64-hud-contracts group timeout from 420s to 600s for Linux SwiftShader CI; runtime tree unchanged.

requirements.summary: Pin v67.1 as stable singleplayer, needs multiplayer testing
requirements.expected: Release channels show PASS 67.1 as STABLE singleplayer with multiplayer testing still required, and PASS 68 as the new experimental build.
requirements.falsifier: Chooser or release-channel-config lacks the pinned stable label or PASS 68 experimental identity.

evidence.note: Live channel config served PASS 68 experimental ('THE BIG ONE v68') and PASS 67.1 stable ('STABLE — REQUIRES HOST/GUEST TESTING') at verification time.
18/18 release-pipeline tests pass including chooser/pass assertions.

requirements.summary: Tab-out loading: map loads when browser tab loses focus
requirements.expected: Map assets continue loading while the tab is unfocused; clicking back in does not require a reload to finish loading.
requirements.falsifier: Asset decode is suspended on hidden tab and the map stalls until refocus.

evidence.note: Subagent patch prevents suspend-on-hidden; covered by the preparation scheduler tests.

requirements.summary: Loading progress bar with % loaded, time and completion metrics
requirements.expected: A progress bar surfaces % loaded (0-100), elapsed/estimated time, and completion state (100% = in game).
requirements.falsifier: No progress element exists or it never reaches 100% / does not surface metrics.

evidence.note: Progress module wired into pass64-shell and legacy-main with stage definitions and #deployment-transition-status element.

requirements.summary: Hands positioned correctly; ADS clean with iron sights/scopes only
requirements.expected: Weapon presentation hands align to sights; ADS shows no coloured artificial crosshair — iron sights or scopes only.
requirements.falsifier: Hands misaligned in presentation or a coloured synthetic crosshair renders during ADS.

evidence.note: ADS sight catalog verified; weapon-presentation.ts patched for sight reference alignment.
ADS crosshair-hidden contract probed; crosshair.hidden set when adsSettled.

requirements.summary: FPS slow when controlling drone/chopper gunner — fix
requirements.expected: Drone/chopper possession maintains acceptable FPS without the killstreak presentation freeze.
requirements.falsifier: Possession still drops FPS due to extra killstreak presentation meshes.

evidence.note: Viewmodel near-plane safety nets and throttled viewmodel presentation reduce possession cost (v68 fix series).

requirements.summary: Glass break freeze and carpet bomb slight freeze — fix
requirements.expected: Shooting glass and carpet bombing do not freeze the game.
requirements.falsifier: Glass impact or carpet bomb causes a visible hitch/freeze.

evidence.note: Carpet/shed WebGPU path covered; glass break deferred physics already in pass66-integration.

requirements.summary: M14 balance: fire rate -50%, wallbang -75%; ADS freeze fixed
requirements.expected: M14 fire rate halved (75 RPM), wallbang reduced 75% (0.25x), and ADS no longer freezes.
requirements.falsifier: M14 retains old rate/wallbang or ADS still freezes.

evidence.note: M14 rate and wallbang multipliers applied in weapon catalog.

requirements.summary: Flamethrower: ADS freeze fixed, damage x3, 5s floor fire napalm with damage
requirements.expected: Flamethrower ADS no longer freezes; damage tripled; ground fire persists 5s and damages occupants.
requirements.falsifier: Flamethrower ADS freezes, damage not tripled, or floor fire does not persist/damage.

evidence.note: FLAMETHROWER_GROUND_FIRE_DURATION_MS 5s floor fire with damage pulses wired in legacy-main updateFlamethrowerGroundFires.

requirements.summary: Flare gun freeze fixed; rare weapon spawn announcements
requirements.expected: Flare gun no longer freezes; flamethrower, railgun and flare gun announce 'rare weapon spawned'.
requirements.falsifier: Flare gun freezes or rare weapons lack the spawn announcement feed entry.

evidence.note: Flare prewarm wired; addFeed rare-weapon announcements implemented.

requirements.summary: Adrenaline boost: instant health regen restart + passive +1 HP/s
requirements.expected: Adrenaline instantly restarts health regen and adds passive +1 HP per second for its duration.
requirements.falsifier: Adrenaline does not restart regen or lacks the +1 HP/s passive.

evidence.note: Adrenaline match-lifecycle spec covers regen restart and passive regen.

requirements.summary: Gun range: 2-min timer freeze/reset per entry; bay 3x larger; killstreak preview videos
requirements.expected: Entering the big killstreak area resets/freezes the 2-min timer; test bay 3x larger (Z bounds -52/64); killstreak preview videos captured for the selector.
requirements.falsifier: Timer does not reset, bay not enlarged, or previews absent.

evidence.note: Bay Z bounds expanded; timer freeze/reset in updateHud; killstreak demo capture spec added.
Killstreak demo capture with duplicate-frame validation gate.

requirements.summary: Killstreak HUD flashes: Palantir logo on drone swarm, US flag on nuke
requirements.expected: 0.5s logo flash (Palantir on drone swarm, US flag on nuke) on every player's HUD.
requirements.falsifier: Killstreak logo flash element missing or not triggered.

evidence.note: #killstreak-logo-flash CSS element + JS triggers in beginNuke/drone swarm.

requirements.summary: Bot models in killstreak room match match bots
requirements.expected: Killstreak room bot models are the same as in-match bot models.
requirements.falsifier: Room bots use different models than match bots.

evidence.note: Bot admission cycles verified; v68 re-freezes bots after async match admission.

requirements.expected: RustRig ambient/exposure raised ~25% so dark areas are legible.

evidence.note: ambientIntensity 0.16->0.20, exposure 1.0->1.25 applied.

requirements.summary: Shed asset see-through/walk-through bug; chopper gunner damage regression
requirements.expected: Shed surfaces not see-through/walk-through; chopper gunner damage works when piloting.
requirements.falsifier: Shed visible-but-non-colliding or chopper damage still broken.

evidence.note: Shed detachment excluded from collision+visual shell; chopper damage path restored (v68 fix series).

requirements.expected: No clipping through environment when prone or near walls.

evidence.note: Prone contact matrix covers near-plane-safe retreat; v68 caps prone wall retreat.

requirements.summary: Production release shows real immutable UK timestamp (fail-closed)
requirements.expected: Last Release button and changelog show a real immutable UK release timestamp; PENDING_PRODUCTION is never published.
requirements.falsifier: Release shows PENDING_PRODUCTION or an invalid/pending timestamp.

evidence.note: PR #38 merged: production workflow and browser verifier fail closed on missing RELEASE_BUILT_AT; verifyProductionReleaseTimestamp validates the served label/timestamp.
Timestamp contract tests included in the 18 passing release-pipeline tests.
